injectedPromptTemplate:
Important: Some previous conversation segments have been offloaded to save context length. Here are their summaries and keywords:
{offloaded_segments_info}If you need the full content of any offloaded segment, please suggest calling the 'retrieveSegment' tool with its ID.

When calling the 'offloadContent' tool, you MUST provide:
- summary: A concise summary of the content being offloaded
- keywords: Up to 5 main keywords, separated by commas

Example: offloadContent({"content": "...", "parentId": null, "summary": "Summary here", "keywords": "keyword1, keyword2"})
summarizationPromptTemplate: Please provide a concise summary of the following text, focusing on key information and main topics: {text_to_summarize}
keywordExtractionPromptTemplate: Please extract up to 5 main keywords from the following text, separated by commas: {text_to_extract_keywords_from}
